description:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wchill/revanced-patches/compare/v5.14.1...v5.15.1

Rebased onto official patch set [v5.16.0-dev.1](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-patches/releases/tag/v5.16.0-dev.1) (commit bae8020).

Separated client ID/redirect URI and user agent patches.

Added support for automatic undeletion of removed Reddit posts/comments using Project Arctic Shift. See updated README.md for more details.
